11068|fe5ba491.name: Betty Quin
11068|fe5ba491.text: Hmm... well you seem capable enough. If you truly desire to learn, then nothing will stand in your way! I will guide you through your first steps on what I hope will be a long and fulfilling path.

1317|fcbd9346.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|fcbd9346.text: You are not ready. Speak to Betty Quinn, she's standing by the stairs over there. Return to me when you have achieved a higher enlightenment.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

275491|0edd6da8.name: Randal Emerson
275491|0edd6da8.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

275491|9fd8120c.name: Randal Emerson
275491|9fd8120c.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $N. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

7937|51417c16.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|51417c16.text: Hello there, $c. I am High Tinker Mekkatorque of the exiles of Gnomeregan.

7937|825d4590.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|825d4590.text:
Oh yes, how wonderful! I have been expecting an emissary from your people, and I am very happy to make your acquaintance.

I do wish I could receive you in our home city of Gnomeregan, but our people have recently fallen on hard times and our homeland is, at present, lost to us.

King Bronzebeard is ever a friend to us gnomes, however, and has graciously opened his city to us in this difficult time. 

I hope that your adventures on Azeroth treat you well, and I look forward to further opportunities to learn more of your people. 

Farewell, $N.

963|287add49.name: Deputy Rainer
963|287add49.text:
Hello, $C.  I hope you've come to bolster our ranks.  Beasts and thieves are spilling into our beloved Elwynn, and we barely have enough men to keep the roads safe!

And if you haven't done so, read that notice about Hogger.  He's a beast in yonder woods that must be dealt with.

92481-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92481-accept.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481-accept.title: A Student of the Arcane

92481-complete.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
92481-complete.text:
Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young $c. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92481-complete.title: A Student of the Arcane

92481-progress.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
92481-progress.text: Greetings, $N. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
92481-progress.title: A Student of the Arcane

94947-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
94947-complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, $R.
94947-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions. Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
